content.text: Image point coordinates are in [y, x] format, where y is the vertical axis, x is the horizontal axis; their values are normalized from 0 to 1000, where [0 0] is the top left, [1000 1000] is the bottom right. What object is located just to the left of point [452 14] in the second image, mostly outside of the frame? Choices: A. suitcase. B. person. C. pillow. D. backpack. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
